Name: Abigail's Natural Hair
Author: Naitodesu77
Description:
If you don't know how to use this mod, follow the simple steps below:

1. Download it (duh)
2. Extract it
3. Copy or Move the file to your C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content
4. Go in your game
5. Go visit Abigail

(Optional)
6. Give her gifts until she have full heart
7.Marry her because she is best waifu imo

 Tadaa! You now have a no-dye Abigail! Hope you enjoy the new look!

More upcoming files for different Abigail's portrait.

Downloads.Description: Fixed one of the portrait's miscolor.
